items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: The personnel included Andy Blakeney; ... Ed Montudie Garland

ctx.x: The group was composed of Mr. Blakeney on trumpet; Johnny St. Cyr, Banjo; John Van Epps, piano; Bob McCracken, clarinet; the drummer was unknown; bass a Mr. Boyack (phonetic spelling), the first name unknown, and this was done in 1961.

1973, Crescent Productions presents the Legends of Jazz on the Legends of Jazz label, recorded in Minneapolis, Minnesota. The personnel included Andy Blakeney; Joe Darensbourg; Louis Nelson; Alton Purnell; Ed Montudie Garland; Barry Martyn, Drums.

The songs performed on this date were 'Conti Street Parade'; 'Out in the Cold Again'; 'The Legends Boogie'; 'Apex Blues'; 'Down Among the Sheltering Palms'; 'Louisiana IA'; 'Just a Little While to Stay Here'; 'Old Man Mose'; 'The Redman Blues'; and 'Do You Know What it Means to Miss New Orleans.'
